gloss: to draw a line; to clearly distinguish

definitions.gloss: to draw a clear line between; to distinguish oneself from; to set oneself apart
definitions.explanation: An idiomatic expression meaning to establish a clear distinction or boundary between two things, or to stand clearly apart from others. Often used to describe how something or someone is distinctly different from comparable things.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一線|いっせん}→一線：20110_issen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{画|かく}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This work stands apart from the rest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{私生活|しせいかつ}→私生活：15112_shiseikatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一線|いっせん}を{画|かく}すべきだ。
examples.english: You should draw a clear line between work and private life.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦において→において：06799_nioite⟧⟦{競合他社|きょうごうたしゃ}→競合他社：25602_kyougoutasha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一線|いっせん}→一線：20110_issen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{画|かく}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: That company clearly distinguishes itself from its competitors in quality.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal expression commonly used in written language and news commentary. The pattern is A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一線|いっせん}を{画|かく}す (to draw a line between A and B) or A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一線|いっせん}を{画|かく}す (to distinguish from A). The verb {画|かく}す is a literary form of {画|えが}く meaning to draw or demarcate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一線|いっせん}を{画|かく}す (to stand apart from others)
- ⟦{明確|めいかく}→明確：01664_meikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一線|いっせん}を{画|かく}す (to draw a clear line)
- ⟦{一線|いっせん}→一線：20110_issen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{画|かく}した⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧ (a distinct presence)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{区別|くべつ}する→区別する：26970_kubetsusuru⟧: to distinguish, to differentiate — more everyday and neutral
- ⟦{際立|きわだ}つ→際立つ：07832_kiwadatsu⟧: to stand out, to be conspicuous — focuses on being noticeable
